srs: The equipment maintenance system records Technician, WorkOrder, MaintenanceService, and Machine; each has an id attribute. Each Technician can have zero or more WorkOrder records, and each WorkOrder belongs to exactly one Technician. Each WorkOrder uses exactly one MaintenanceService, and each MaintenanceService serves zero or more WorkOrder records. Each MaintenanceService manages one or more Machine records by composition, and each Machine belongs to exactly one MaintenanceService. Each Technician can reference zero or more Machine records, and each Machine can be referenced by zero or more Technician records.
